{{Top|leg}}
The '''Insight implant''' stimulated the less-often-used neural networks in the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], which would grant the user the ability to see alternate solutions they may not have otherwise considered.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 14 or higher.
